citations.claim: initial total energy before the step
first violating step: energy jumps with no collisions or controller work

counterfactual.change: reduce dt from 1/30 to 1e-4 with all else identical; fast-body substep splitting no longer triggers and energy is conserved

explanation: Single body in free flight (no walls touched, no controller work, no collisions) gains ~165 J in one dt=1/30 step. vy goes -30 to -36 (delta -6 vs expected -g*dt=-1) and substeps_in_step=44, so gravity/velocity integration is over-applied when fast-body substep splitting activates, injecting energy and tripping energy_bound.
vision_note: The blue body falls a visibly large distance in a single step while alone in empty space with no walls or contacts nearby. There is no collision or controller interaction to explain a sudden energy gain, just unobstructed free flight.
